description.en: Official inauguration ceremony marking the formal kick-off of the Optica Egypt Local Section. Bringing together students, researchers, universities, and industry partners to celebrate Egypt's charter in the global photonics ecosystem and unveil the section's five-pillar operational roadmap.

title.en: Hands-On Workshop: Open-Source Silicon Photonics with gdsfactory

description.en: An intensive technical workshop introducing university students and graduation project teams to programmatic photonic integrated circuit layout using Python, gdsfactory, KLayout, and Meep FDTD with zero commercial licensing barriers.

description.en: A deep-dive scientific seminar exploring how micro-electro-mechanical interferometers, silicon photonics, and chemometric algorithms enable portable spectral sensing for agriculture, healthcare, and industrial quality control.
